gloss: dining and dashing, eating without paying

definitions.gloss: dining and dashing, eating without paying
definitions.explanation: The act of eating at a restaurant and leaving without paying the bill.

examples.japanese: {食|く}い{逃|に}げ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧だ。
examples.english: Dining and dashing is a crime.

examples.japanese: {食|く}い{逃|に}げ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{捕|つか}まった→捕まる：01959_tsukamaru⟧。
examples.english: A customer who dined and dashed was caught by the police.

examples.japanese: {食|く}い{逃|に}げ⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{先払|さきばら}い→先払い：26930_sakibarai⟧にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Some restaurants require payment in advance to prevent dine-and-dash incidents.

notes:
USAGE:
Also used as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb: {食|く}い{逃|に}げ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. Legally, this is classified as {詐欺罪|さぎざい} (fraud) in Japan.

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{食|く}う→食う：02657_kuu⟧ (to eat, informal) + ⟦{逃|に}げる→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧ (to run away). A compound describing eating then fleeing.

SIMILAR WORDS:
{飲|の}み{逃|に}げ (drinking and dashing) follows the same pattern. ⟦{万引|まんび}き→万引き：16838_manbiki⟧ (shoplifting) is a related concept for stealing goods rather than services.
